scheme_name: Kali Bai Bheel Medhavi Chhatra Scooty Scheme
other_conditions: Must have passed class 12th with a minimum of 65% marks in Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education or a minimum of 75% marks in Central Board of Secondary Education
Must be studying in any school in Rajasthan
Must have a graduation degree from a Rajasthan‑based college and be a regular student
No gap of one year is allowed between passing class 12th and admission to a bachelor's degree program
Girl students who have already received a scooty under any prior state scheme based on marks in any class are not eligible for a scooty under this scheme
benefits_summary: Distribution of electric or standard scooties to eligible girl students.
